query:
SELECT id FROM twitch_stream_sessions
              WHERE ended_at IS NULL
                AND (twitch_user_id = $2
                     OR (streamer_login = $1
                         AND (twitch_user_id IS NULL OR $2::text IS NULL)))
              ORDER BY (twitch_user_id = $2) DESC NULLS LAST, started_at DESC
              LIMIT 1
